core_categories: Home Medical Equipment; Respiratory Care; Sleep Therapy; Diabetes Care; Durable Medical Equipment; Wellness & Specialty Care
specialty_focus: AdaptHealth is a U.S. network of home medical equipment (HME) companies that rents medical devices and delivers daily-living supplies directly to patients at home. It specializes in chronic and home-based care, managing conditions like COPD, sleep apnea, and neuromuscular diseases, as well as recurring supply management for device reorders and maintenance.
